title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Plant Organic HMW gDNA Extraction
author: Benjamin Jackson
materials: Proceed to appropriate QC checks and downstream processing.

steps.title: Prepare Direct Plant Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Direct Plant Lysis Buffer and preheat it for 15–30 mins at 65 °C and 400 rpm to ensure all reagents are dissolved. Immediately prior to use, add DTT and Proteinase K and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot 65–100 mg of cryogenically disrupted tissue samples (minimum >15 mg) into individual 2 mL Lo-Bind tubes on dry ice. Transfer tubes to wet ice for 10 minutes to equilibrate temperature.

steps.title: Perform Direct Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Lysis the samples using preheated buffer and RNase A.

substeps.instruction: Add 550 μL of preheated direct plant lysis buffer (65 ºC) to each sample.
Immediately pulse vortex 5 times at full speed until homogenous; if not homogenous, continuously vortex for 5 seconds.
Place samples on a heat block at 55 ºC and 600 rpm.
Inspect samples by inverting to mix; use a wide bore P1000 tip to break up any remaining aggregates.
After 15 minutes of incubation, add 4 µL RNase A (optionally diluted in 6 µL PBS) to each sample and pulse-vortex 5 times to resuspend particles.
Incubate for another 45 minutes at 55 °C and 600 rpm. Resuspend by inversion or wide bore P1000 tip as needed, but do not agitate during the final 15 minutes of lysis.

steps.title: Prepare Potassium Acetate Solution
steps.instruction: While samples are incubating, prepare fresh 2 mL Lo-Bind tubes containing 150 μL of cold potassium acetate solution (4 °C; 5 M; pH 7.4) and incubate on wet ice.

steps.title: Isolate Supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove samples from the heat block and allow lysate to settle for 1 to 5 minutes. Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 8,000 rpm at room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate gDNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant using a wide bore P1000 tip to the tubes containing 150 μL cold potassium acetate solution (4 °C; 5 M; pH 7.4). Mix until homogeneous by inversion or pipetting. Incubate on wet ice for 5 minutes (up to one hour).

steps.title: First Chloroform Separation (C:IA)
steps.instruction: Perform the first separation in a chemical fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL cold chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (–20 °C; 24:1, v/v) to the samples.
Mix on a tube rotator at 25 rpm for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer up to 700 μL of the aqueous phase (top layer) to a fresh 2 mL Lo-Bind tube using a wide bore P1000 tip, aspirating from the top to avoid the interphase.

steps.title: Second Chloroform Separation (C:IA)
steps.instruction: Perform the second separation in a chemical fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL cold chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (–20 °C; 24:1, v/v) to the sample.
Mix on a tube rotator at 25 rpm for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer up to 600 μL of the aqueous phase (top layer) to the applicable empty well of the Sample Plate using a wide bore P1000 tip.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the following plates and reagents, ensuring 500 μL Sera-Mag™ Speedbead solution and 175 μL AMPure® PB beads are equilibrated to room temperature and the tabletop centrifuge is pre-chilled to 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Sera-Mag™ SpeedBead solution to each sample in the POE Sample Plate.
POE Tip plate 1 (1 mL 96-well tip comb): No reagent.
POE Sample plate (1 mL): Up to 600 μL aqueous phase + 500 μL Sera-Mag™ Speedbead solution.
POE Ethanol wash 1.1 (1 mL): 1 mL 80% ETOH.
POE Ethanol wash 1.2 (1 mL): 1 mL 80% ETOH.
POE Elution Plate 1 (1 mL): 400 µL Buffer EB.
POE Tip plate 2 (1 mL): 96-well tip comb (no reagent).
POE Ethanol wash 2 (1 mL): 1 mL 80% ETOH.
POE Elution Plate 2 (200 µL): 135 µL Buffer EB.

steps.title: Automated DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Run the extraction on the KingFisher™ Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the required DNA extraction protocol and press play.
Load the filled plates onto the instrument and initiate the run.
When prompted after the initial 1X SpeedBead SPRI, add 175 µL (0.45X) AMPure PB beads to each well in 'POE Elution Plate 1', replace the plate, and continue.
When the 0.45X AMPure PB SPRI is finished, remove 'POE Elution Plate 2' and transfer the 135 µL sample eluate to a storage tube using a wide bore p200 tip.

steps.title: Final Solubilization and Storage
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at room temperature overnight to allow uHMW gDNA to solubilise. Store long-term at 4 °C.
